The '''derrick major''' was an area on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that had [[Docks under the derrick major/Legends|cargo docks]] underneath it.

==History==
The docks under the derrick major were used for loading and unloading containers and had many lifting cranes operating out of the side of a building.

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A [[Wikipedia:Derrick|derrick]] is a type of tower or mast used for lifting.
